subject.title: feat(channels): add typed cross-surface approval actions

question: Should an authorized canonical resolve request with the wrong exec/plugin kind terminally deny the located approval as a malformed verdict?
rationale: The umbrella design calls for malformed verdicts to fail closed, but extending that rule to an owner-routing mismatch can turn a stale or incorrectly encoded control into a terminal decision; implementation evidence cannot establish the intended security policy.

options.title: Reject mismatch without mutation
options.body: Return a not-found or kind-mismatch result and preserve the pending record, while retaining terminal denial for malformed or disallowed decisions on the correct owner.

options.title: Keep terminal fail-closed denial
options.body: Treat any authenticated wrong-kind canonical resolve as a malformed verdict and document and prove that behavior across channel callbacks.

recommendation.title: Reject mismatch without mutation
recommendation.body: Return a not-found or kind-mismatch result and preserve the pending record, while retaining terminal denial for malformed or disallowed decisions on the correct owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the typed presentation action API and authored the canonical issue and both stacked approval increments governing this choice.
